description: Read-only XRPL transaction lookup for one canonical transaction hash. `transaction` is the required hash; set `binary=true` only when binary-encoded transaction data is required, otherwise use the normal transaction representation. The result retrieves transaction data for that hash without modifying the ledger, and calls are subject to the configured gateway rate limits. Use this when the transaction hash is already known; use n9t2_xrpl_list_account_transactions for account-wide transaction history instead.

binary.description: Whether to return the transaction in binary encoded form.
binary.title: Binary

transaction.description: Canonical XRPL transaction hash to retrieve.
transaction.title: Transaction

name: n9t2_xrpl_get_transaction
